heading: Verify a checksum
help: Computes a checksum of the retained original, for example to compare it with the value published with a release or archive copy. The file is read completely; large files take a while.
expectedHelp: Paste the hexadecimal value, or a line from a checksum file. Leave empty to compute only.
computed: Checksum computed. No published value was given to compare.
match: The original matches the published checksum.
mismatch: The original does not match the published checksum.
weakHelp: SHA-1 and MD5 identify a file but no longer prove that it was not deliberately altered. Prefer SHA-256 or stronger when the publisher offers it.
damaged: The retained original no longer matches its recorded SHA-256. Restore it from a backup before relying on it.
invalid: The checksum could not be computed.
